message: それぞれの想い
--Two days left until parting ways with Lolotte.

name: Synn
message: 「...Thank you very much!」
For the past few days, squeezing in time between Student Council duties, I'd been stopping by the shopping district after school to work.
The part-time jobs that folks from the shopping district like Old Man Amakawa and Tame-san had introduced me to were now over.
They were just temporary day-labor gigs, yet everyone treated me so well.
And they gave me tons of encouragement, too.
For some reason, everyone knew that we'd managed to deal with Re-Crea.
And for some reason, they threw in a generous bonus in my pay for that achievement.
Could it be... that besides Lolotte, there are other angels in Ryuusei Town, or demons secretly living just like humans?
Or maybe, just like the feelings we hold, race doesn't even matter anymore.

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, the previous generation's missus was an angel, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh...? Wait, does that mean my mom is an angel?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Oh, didn't I tell ya?」

name: Synn
message: 「This is the first I'm hearing of it!!」
It seems there are still plenty of things in this world I don't know about.
At this rate, once Lolotte comes back, it looks like we'll be able to enjoy going on adventures together again.
Breaking into every last bit of my meager savings, I tightly grip the brown envelope full of cash and head toward the shop Misa told me about.

name: Synn
message: 「Excuse me... about this ring. For the size--」
A Christmas present from me to Lolotte.
--A pair of silver rings.
Scrambling to get the money together, measuring her ring size in a goofy way, it was a present I barely managed to pull off at my absolute limit.
As long as we have these, even when the two of us are far apart, we'll always be connected.
Everyone on the Student Council who helped me out... thank you so much!
During these precious few days... I wanted to spend as much time with Lolotte as I possibly could, though.
It's not like this means we'll never see each other again.
Precisely because we believe we'll reunite, we were able to spend time apart from each other.
I wonder what Lolotte's been up to while I've been doing all this...?

name: Lolotte
message: 「How is this, Jiiya? Will doing it like this suffice?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Yes, that is spot-on. Next, just like this...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoho~~. By doing it this way, it really takes shape properly, doesn't it?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Since this is your trademark, milady, we must craft it with utmost care.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Do you think everyone will be pleased with it...?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Why, of course. Moreover, upon hearing that it was handmade by you, milady, everyone is sure to be astounded.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hey, Jiiya. That makes it sound like everyone thinks I'm completely hopeless.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hehe... Isn't that precisely why you're keeping it a secret to surprise everyone?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes, that's right!」

name: Riesling
message: 「You truly... have become quite skilled.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's because you taught me so earnestly, Jiiya.」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, time for the final stretch!」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady. When you grow weary, leave the herbal tea to this humble Riesling Tooyama.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Thank you very much, Jiiya.\s04」

name: Azel
message: 「What is Lolotte doing?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「She says she's making presents for everyone who has taken care of her.」

name: Azel
message: 「Hmm. So that is why she has been wrestling with yarn all this time.」

name: Riesling
message: 「If you are interested, why don't the two of you ask my lady to teach you as well?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Wha--me!?」

name: Amyrina
message: 「That's a brilliant idea! Azel, let's learn how to knit together!」

name: Azel
message: 「I shall pass.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It's okay. I was super clumsy when I first started too.」

name: Amyrina
message: 「N-Nobody said it was because you're clumsy, Azel.\s01」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oops, right you are. So sorry, teehee.」

name: Azel
message: 「Good grief...\s10 However, it may be ideal for passing the time in Heaven.」

name: Riesling
message: 「My lady. I, Riesling Tooyama, shall wait faithfully until the day we can spend joyful days together again.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes. By then, I'll come back so good at this that I'm sure you'll be amazed, Jiiya!」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hehehe... I look forward to it.」
